name: ELEVATE: Adrianna (CA) + Sheila
description: ELEVATE returns to Lust Porto with a techno night featuring Adrianna, a rising name in international techno, and Sheila, who has more than 25 years behind the decks in Portugal. Jorginho opens the night.
longDescription:
ELEVATE returns to Lust Porto for a night of techno on Friday, November 13. Adrianna has releases on labels including Terminal M, Codex, Tronic and We Are The Brave, and runs her own label, TMPL Music. Her productions and DJ sets have been supported by Charlotte de Witte, Adam Beyer, Joseph Capriati and Nicole Moudaber.

Sheila has more than 25 years behind the decks in Portugal's techno scene. She founded the label Digital Waves and has releases on Autektone, Codex and Gain. Jorginho opens the night.

The party runs from midnight to 6:00 at Lust Porto, Rua do Conde de Vizela 89, Porto, and is for ages 18 and over. Early bird tickets cost €8.00, with later ticket phases still to go on sale. Tickets can be resold through the Shotgun app.

longDescriptionPt:

As suas produções e DJ sets contam com o apoio de Charlotte de Witte, Adam Beyer, Joseph Capriati e Nicole Moudaber.

Sheila tem mais de 25 anos de carreira no techno em Portugal. É fundadora da editora Digital Waves e tem lançamentos na Autektone, Codex e Gain. Jorginho abre a noite.

A festa decorre da meia-noite às 6:00 no Lust Porto, Rua do Conde de Vizela 89, Porto, e é para maiores de 18 anos. Os bilhetes early bird custam 8,00€, e as fases seguintes ainda vão abrir. Os bilhetes podem ser revendidos através da aplicação Shotgun.
